decisions: D1 start of a Partial video receipt = min over delivered pictures of meta.pts (the pts of the packet the picture came from, the same pts the packet loop gives that chunk), end = max over delivered pictures of meta.pts + meta.duration; both are order-independent (min/max), so a decoder that releases pictures out of presentation order (B-frames) is covered; both live in one Option<(u64, u64)> so start and end cannot disagree about whether a picture was delivered

D2 no picture delivered -> start stays the packet start and end = start (the empty-span convention of this crate, unchanged from SMB-REEL-PARTIAL-PTS); the span can never be reversed because every picture has end >= start (duration is a u64 converted checked into i64) and min of starts <= max of ends

D3 only the Partial branch changes: when every picture arrived the packet receipt is not touched (also pinned by fully_delivered_video_receipt_end_is_the_packet_end and by the Works rows of the other tests); requested span, disposition (Partial), complete=false and units are as before; an Export with a shortfall still returns Incomplete before the span is patched

D4 picture_span() adds one conversion over the old picture_end(): u64::try_from(pts) with the packet receipt's variant (Unsupported negative-presentation-time), run after the sink took the picture and after the end check. By reading isobmff.rs build_presentation (presented entries in non-decreasing presentation time, each edit starts at or after the previous end) and deliver_packets (start_actual = to_ticks(wanted[0].pts)? already refuses a negative first pts) every delivered picture's pts is >= wanted[0].pts >= 0, so the new refusal is unreachable through the demuxers; no test builds a negative non-first entry (code reading, not executed)

D5 PLR-088 fixture reuses the crate's mp4_bytes/Mp4Spec (ctts offsets + edit list, the same technique as tests/foundation_contract.rs gop_spec and tests/engine_video.rs frag_spec); a small av01_clip() helper in the test file replaces the inline spec of the old repeating-list test (also used by it), no new fixture file and no second copy of the fake decoder

D6 test names: the table test is renamed (its content changed: start and end per row), the fully-delivered test keeps its name (its content now matches it), two names are new; DESCRIPTOR rule and tests list updated in the same commit
residuals: R1 a reordering decoder that releases a picture with a later TAG before earlier ones still drains the earlier pending packets in Forward::accept (existing behaviour, untouched, residual R2 of SMB-REEL-PARTIAL-PTS): their pictures count as dropped; the out-of-order test releases pictures in tag order and varies PRESENTATION order, which is what the span depends on

R2 the fake decoder releases each picture synchronously inside send() and nothing in finish(); a decoder that holds pictures until finish() (R21-R2 second half) is not exercised by a new fake plan; by code Forward::accept also runs from session.finish() (video.rs:542-544) before the Partial branch (video.rs:549), so the span includes them
